payroll_review_procedure.content: Payroll Review Procedure v4.2. Step 1: pull current and prior runs. Step 2: reconcile headcount against roster. Step 3: flag per-employee gross variance >25% or >$2,000, any overtime >$3,000, terminated employees on the run, and new hires lacking onboarding records. Step 4: prepare variance report for Payroll Manager sign-off. Step 5: ONLY after sign-off, distribute report and post to GL.

variance_thresholds.content: Materiality thresholds FY2026: per-employee gross delta flagged at >25% OR >$2,000 absolute; department-level delta flagged at >$10,000; total run delta flagged at >5%. Overtime concentration flagged when single-employee OT exceeds $3,000.
